title: cps-okf — Custom field data payload
description: Custom field VALUE writes (the dedicated custom-field endpoint), separate from element create and status update. Each entry is a native customFieldData record: {object, objectId, customFieldId, periodId?, value}. `value` is always a string. Include periodId for period-scoped update-field values (status reporting); omit it for non-period edit-field values. Field DEFINITIONS are created in the elements/setup pass; this payload only sets values.
